## CodecResult type

Outcome of encoding or decoding a value.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type CodecResult<T> =
  | {
      readonly ok: true
      readonly value: T
    }
  | {
      readonly ok: false
      readonly issues: readonly ValidationIssue[]
    }
```

**References:** [ValidationIssue](./contracts.validationissue.md)

## Remarks
